questions.prompt: Which producer made the beat for "Kaam 25" (2018), DIVINE's song for *Sacred Games*?
questions.explanation: Phenom (Pinaki Rattan) made it. Scroll praised how the production matches the menace in the lyrics. Genius also lists DIVINE as co-producer.

questions.prompt: In February 2019, DIVINE became the first Indian guest on which host's Beats 1 radio show?
questions.explanation: It was Ebro Darden's show, at Apple's LA studio; RS India and Gulf News call DIVINE its first Indian guest. Zane Lowe and Julie Adenuga were Beats 1's other launch hosts.

questions.prompt: On *Gunehgar* (2022), which US rapper features on "Traffic Jam"?
questions.explanation: Jadakiss is on "Traffic Jam". Russ is on "Bornfire" from the same album. Dave East was on "Remand" (*Kohinoor*), and Pusha T on "Jungle Mantra".

questions.prompt: Where was the video for "100 Million" (2024), DIVINE's first song with Karan Aujla, shot?
questions.explanation: It was shot in Dubai, directed by Rupan Bal and team. The song came out on 18 Jan 2024; Aujla called it a birthday gift to fans. It was DIVINE's top song on Apple Music (Nov 2026).

bar: Main karte rahoonga grind jab tak 6 men de haath
questions.prompt: Who are the "6 men"?
questions.explanation: "Until six men lend a hand" means until six men carry his coffin: he'll grind till the day he dies. "6 men" also keeps the rhyme with "lame men" and "real men" in the bars before.

questions.prompt: Clue card. Grew up in Sahar, then the JB Nagar slums of Andheri East. First crew: Mumbai's Finest. What is DIVINE's real name?
questions.explanation: DIVINE is Vivian Fernandes. He moved to JB Nagar at about age 10, and rapped in English with Mumbai's Finest before switching to Hindi.

questions.prompt: At the 65th Filmfare Awards (2020), DIVINE and Ankur Tewari won Best Lyrics for which *Gully Boy* song?
questions.explanation: "Apna Time Aayega" won Best Lyrics. In the film Ranveer Singh sings it. DIVINE first wrote "Sabka Time Aayega"; Javed Akhtar suggested "Apna".

questions.prompt: DIVINE made "Kaam 25" (June 2018) for which series?
questions.explanation: "Kaam 25" was made for Netflix's *Sacred Games*. The press tied the "25" to the 25 days Sartaj Singh has to save Mumbai. The official video is on Netflix's YouTube channel.

questions.prompt: "Chorni" came out on 7 Jul 2023, after the death of DIVINE's co-artist on it. Who is the co-artist?
questions.explanation: It was Sidhu Moose Wala's fourth posthumous release. Their first song together was "Moosedrilla" on *Moosetape* (2021).

bar: Kaam 25 hai
questions.prompt: What does "Kaam 25" mean, as the song itself explains?
questions.explanation: The very next line is "Bole toh, game over". "Bole toh" is Mumbai street talk for "in other words", so "Kaam 25" means game over: the job is done, you're finished.

bar: Mujhe game saath dera jaise liya maine saat phera
questions.prompt: Simile or metaphor?
questions.explanation: "Jaise" (like) marks a simile. The game sticks by him as if he'd taken the seven wedding rounds (saat phere) with it. "Saath" (with) and "saat" (seven) sit side by side.

questions.prompt: DIVINE was an altar boy, and his stage name grew out of his first rhymes. What kind of rhymes were they?
questions.explanation: He started in gospel rap, writing devotional rhymes. His grandmother took him to church every day. He told The Goan the name felt right: "God's child".

questions.prompt: DIVINE's debut album *Kohinoor* (9 Oct 2019) was the first release from which label?
questions.explanation: Mass Appeal India was launched on 21 Aug 2019 by Nas's Mass Appeal and Universal Music. DIVINE was its first signing. *Kohinoor* is co-released with his own Gully Gang.

questions.prompt: In December 2020, a Spotify billboard in New York's Times Square promoted which DIVINE album?
questions.explanation: It was reported as the first Times Square billboard for an Indian rapper. In 2021 he called it his biggest achievement.

questions.prompt: Which launch artist features on DIVINE's song "Bag"?
questions.explanation: "Bag (feat. KR$NA)" is listed on KR$NA's Apple Music page. Ikka and Badshah have other songs with DIVINE.

questions.prompt: Which 2019 JioSaavn Original put DIVINE with Nas and Naezy, with Ranveer Singh on the chorus?
questions.explanation: "NY Se Mumbai" (12 Feb 2019) was DIVINE and Naezy's first song together since 2015. Nas was an executive producer of *Gully Boy*.

questions.prompt: "Satya" (*Punya Paap*, 2020) borrows the chorus of which song from the 1998 film *Satya*?
questions.explanation: It interpolates the "Goli Maar" chorus (music by Vishal Bhardwaj, lyrics by Gulzar). Karan Kanchan produced it.

bar: Liya nahi chayan tab toh
Heera yeh chain mein
questions.prompt: Which two meanings of "chain" does he use?
questions.explanation: Hindi "chain" (चैन) is rest; English "chain" is the necklace. He never took rest, so now there's a diamond on his chain. Same sound, two languages.

bar: Chhutta paisa rakh ke dekh laya na change
questions.prompt: Which two meanings does "change" carry?
questions.explanation: "Chhutta paisa" (loose coins) sets up "change" as coins; the English word pays off as "I changed the game". Two languages, one joke.

bar: Ram naam satya hai
Yeh khule aam hatya hai
questions.prompt: When is "Ram naam satya hai" usually chanted?
questions.explanation: It's the funeral chant. He turns it into a threat: the killing is in broad daylight, and your funeral has begun. "Satya hai / hatya hai" is a three-syllable rhyme.

bar: Gardi mein fark nahi
Charsi aur vardi mein
questions.prompt: Who does "vardi" (uniform) stand for?
questions.explanation: The uniform stands for the cop wearing it. In the crowd, you can't tell a stoner (charsi) from the police. "Gardi / vardi" is a perfect rhyme.

bar: Kuch saath mai na laaye
Wo paisa hi kya hai jisko, saath mai na ___
questions.prompt: Complete the bar.
questions.explanation: We brought nothing into the world, so what good is money you don't eat together? "Saath mein na" comes back with a new sense, and "laaye / khaaye" rhyme.

questions.prompt: Who produced "Mere Gully Mein" (2015), DIVINE and Naezy's breakout?
questions.explanation: Sez on the Beat (Sajeel Kapoor) made it. RS India put its video first in its 10 best Indian music videos of 2015. *Gully Boy* later remade it with Ranveer Singh's verses.

questions.prompt: DIVINE's first rhymes were devotional, inspired by which US Christian rapper?
questions.explanation: Lecrae inspired his gospel-rap start, which gave him the name DIVINE. A friend's 50 Cent T-shirt had first pulled him towards rap.

questions.prompt: One producer worked on the title tracks "Kohinoor" (2019) and "Punya Paap" (2020), plus "NY Se Mumbai" (2019). Who?
questions.explanation: iLL Wayno worked on all three; "NY Se Mumbai" was co-produced with XD Pro. Stunnah Beatz made "3:59 AM", Phenom made "Gandhi Money", and Hit-Boy made "Gunehgar".

questions.prompt: "Apna Time Aayega" was composed by DIVINE and which producer?
questions.explanation: Dub Sharma and DIVINE composed it. Ankur Tewari co-wrote the lyrics and was the film's music supervisor. Ranveer Singh sings it.

questions.prompt: Karan Kanchan made the "Baazigar" beat in January 2021. Why did the song wait until *Gunehgar* (Nov 2022)?

options.text: It was held for a film

questions.explanation: It samples "Baazigar O Baazigar" (1993, Anu Malik), and the clearance took time. Gully Gang's A&R lead sent Kanchan a list of songs that could be cleared.

questions.prompt: Which two US rappers join DIVINE on "Jungle Mantra" (2021), made for Netflix's *The White Tiger*?
questions.explanation: Pusha T and Vince Staples. Pusha T later co-headlined Gully Fest 2024 with DIVINE in Mumbai.

questions.prompt: DIVINE and Badshah's first song together, "Bach Ke Rehna" (2021), was made for which Netflix film?
questions.explanation: With Jonita Gandhi, produced by Mikey McCleary, it reworks "Bachke Rehna Re Baba". They met again on "O'Sajna" from Badshah's *Ek Tha Raja* (2024).

questions.prompt: Ikka's single "Level Up" (Oct 2020) features DIVINE and which other rapper?
questions.explanation: The single is "Level Up (feat. Divine & Kaater)", 26 Oct 2020, on Mass Appeal India and Universal Music India.

questions.prompt: DIVINE was nominated for MTV EMA Best India Act four times by 2023. Which year did he win?
questions.explanation: He won in 2021, at the ceremony in Budapest (14 Nov). He was also nominated in 2018, 2020 and 2023; 2023 went to Tsumyoki.

questions.prompt: In 2015, which label signed DIVINE and called him "the Voice of the Streets"?
questions.explanation: Sony's release is dated 21 Oct 2015. The deal ended amicably by early 2018; he moved to Only Much Louder, then started Gully Gang.

questions.prompt: Who co-founded Gully Gang Entertainment with DIVINE in 2019, and also manages him?
questions.explanation: Chaitanya Kataria. Gully Gang (launched Feb 2019) covers a record label, Gully Fest, merch and content. Joel D'Souza (JD) directs his videos; Chinmay Deshpande is Gully Gang's A&R lead.

questions.prompt: DIVINE's April 2020 diss track "Chaabi Wala Bandar", aimed at Emiway Bantai, is named after what?
questions.explanation: RS India (18 Apr 2020) says the title refers to the "Musical Jolly Chimp", a battery-operated toy by Daishin C.K. It traced the exchange to a remark about Emiway's name at a gig, which DIVINE reused on "Remand" (2019).

bar: Bhagwaan mujhe bola divine paani pe chal
questions.prompt: Which later DIVINE album shares this bar's image?
questions.explanation: "Paani pe chal" is walking on water, Jesus's miracle in the Gospels, and "divine" is both his name and "godly". Apple says *Walking on Water* (Dec 2025) nods to his gospel-rap start.

bar: Nas wale mode mein
Khoon se behtar koi nahi shaks wale mode mein
questions.prompt: Besides the US rapper, what does "nas" mean in Hindi?
questions.explanation: "Nas" is the US rapper and the Hindi word for a vein, which is what blood runs in. Nas also features on "Walking Miracle" on the same album.

bar: Kaptani innings yeh hai Kohli wala shot
Ghar ke bahar tere paunche yeh rangoli wala shot
questions.prompt: "Wala shot" repeats at the end of both lines (the radeef). Which words rhyme just before it (the qaafiya)?
questions.explanation: The radeef is the end phrase that repeats ("wala shot"). The rhyme just before it, Kohli / rangoli, is the qaafiya. "Shot" works as a cricket shot and a diss.

bar: Alag kutte, yeh kaat’te yeh bhaunkte nahi
Alag ghode, yeh thokte yeh daudte nahi
questions.prompt: In Bambaiya slang, what is a "ghoda"?
questions.explanation: "Ghoda" (horse) is Bambaiya for a gun, from the trigger. So these "horses" don't run, they fire. The dogs bite without barking.

bar: Paani hai gehra aur
Shooter sab shark se hain
questions.prompt: Look at "shooter sab shark se". Simile or metaphor?
questions.explanation: "Se" (plural of "sa") means "like", so the shooters are like sharks: a simile. (The deep water standing for Mumbai is a metaphor.)

bar: Moosa, Nipsey, Pac, Moosa, Nipsey, Pac
Uh, seekha maine inse, what is real hip-hop
questions.prompt: What do all three have in common?

options.text: All three were from Los Angeles

questions.explanation: Sidhu Moose Wala ("Moosa", after his village), Nipsey Hussle and Tupac were all shot dead: in 2022, 2019 and 1996.

bar: Circle rakta tight aur main circle jitna Fuck deta
questions.prompt: Going by the shape, how much does he care?
questions.explanation: He keeps his circle tight, and gives as many f***s as a circle: a circle looks like 0. Same word, two jobs: his crew, then the shape.
